description:
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Witch-Maw Nephilim's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 1/1 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Wurm, adding {C}{C}.
When the Wurm dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.
